title: Dominoes: double-six tile matching on open chain
description: 2-4 players, 28 tiles (double-six set, already in registry: registry/tiles/dominoes-double-six.json). Draw from boneyard (hidden ordered_stack). Play tiles matching open ends of the chain. Chain topology: linear with branches at doubles (doubles placed crosswise). Scoring variant (Muggins/All Fives): score when open ends sum to multiple of 5. Blocking variant: first to empty hand wins, blocked game goes to lowest pip count. Pass when no playable tile. Demonstrates: chain/graph topology that grows during play, tile orientation (which end connects where), multiple scoring variants in one definition. Perfect information once drawn (hand is private, boneyard count visible). Already have domino tiles in registry.
